zh.name: 代码审查清单
zh.description: 审查代码改动时用：按严重程度检查正确性、安全、性能、可读性，并给出具体修改建议

en.name: Code review checklist
en.description: Use when reviewing code changes: check correctness, security, performance and readability by severity, with concrete fixes

zh.name: 写好提交说明
zh.description: 提交代码（git commit）时用：一句话标题加说明为什么改，一个提交只做一件事

en.name: Good commit messages
en.description: Use when committing code: a one-line summary plus why the change was made, one logical change per commit

zh.name: 发 GitHub Release
zh.description: 发布新版本到 GitHub 时用：检查、打标签、写更新说明、上传安装包，每一步都先确认

en.name: Publish a GitHub release
en.description: Use when publishing a new version on GitHub: checks, tag, release notes and uploading build files, confirming each step

zh.name: 写单元测试
zh.description: 给代码写自动化测试时用：先测正常情况，再测边界和错误，测试要能真的跑起来

en.name: Writing unit tests
en.description: Use when writing automated tests: normal cases first, then edge cases and errors, and make sure the tests actually run

zh.name: 系统化排查 bug
zh.description: 修 bug 时用：先复现、再缩小范围找到根本原因，修完验证并防止再犯

en.name: Systematic debugging
en.description: Use when fixing a bug: reproduce it, narrow it down to the root cause, fix, verify and prevent it coming back

zh.name: 写 README
zh.description: 给项目写或改 README 时用：一句话说明是什么，然后怎么装、怎么用、怎么贡献

en.name: Writing a README
en.description: Use when writing or updating a project's README: what it is in one sentence, then install, use and contribute

zh.name: 小红书笔记
zh.description: 写小红书笔记时用：抓人的标题、口语化分段正文、话题标签，避免违禁词和夸大宣传

en.name: Xiaohongshu (RED) post
en.description: Use when writing a Xiaohongshu post: catchy title, conversational body, hashtags, no banned or exaggerated claims

zh.name: 公众号文章
zh.description: 写微信公众号文章时用：标题、导语、小标题分段、金句和结尾引导，适合手机阅读

en.name: WeChat article
en.description: Use when writing a WeChat Official Account article: title, lead, sections with subheadings, and a closing call to action, readable on a phone

zh.name: 短视频脚本
zh.description: 写抖音、视频号、Reels 等短视频脚本时用：3 秒钩子、分镜表、口播台词和结尾引导

en.name: Short video script
en.description: Use when writing scripts for TikTok, Reels or Shorts: a 3-second hook, shot table, voice-over lines and a call to action

zh.name: SEO 博客文章
zh.description: 写要被搜索引擎找到的博客文章时用：关键词、标题结构、元描述和内部链接

en.name: SEO blog post
en.description: Use when writing a blog post meant to rank in search: keyword, heading structure, meta description and internal links

zh.name: 竞品分析
zh.description: 分析竞争对手时用：上网查资料，按产品、价格、渠道、内容对比，最后给出可执行的建议

en.name: Competitor analysis
en.description: Use when analysing competitors: research online, compare product, price, channels and content, and end with actionable advice

zh.name: 内容排期表
zh.description: 规划一段时间的发布计划时用：按平台和日期排好主题、形式和负责人

en.name: Content calendar
en.description: Use when planning posts over a period: topics, formats and owners laid out by platform and date

zh.name: 广告文案多版本
zh.description: 写广告文案时用：针对不同卖点和人群写多个版本，方便测试哪个效果好

en.name: Ad copy variants
en.description: Use when writing ad copy: several versions for different angles and audiences, ready to A/B test

zh.name: 会议纪要
zh.description: 整理会议记录时用：结论、待办（谁、做什么、什么时候）、未决问题，一页看完

en.name: Meeting minutes
en.description: Use when writing up a meeting: decisions, action items (who, what, by when) and open questions on one page

zh.name: 周报
zh.description: 写工作周报时用：本周完成、进行中、下周计划、风险和需要的支持，用事实和数字说话

en.name: Weekly report
en.description: Use when writing a weekly status report: done, in progress, next week, risks and help needed, with facts and numbers

zh.name: 商务邮件
zh.description: 写工作邮件时用：主题说清楚目的、第一句给结论、明确要对方做什么和什么时候

en.name: Business email
en.description: Use when writing a work email: a clear subject, the point in the first sentence, and a clear ask with a deadline

zh.name: 上网调研报告
zh.description: 需要查资料写报告时用：多方搜索、交叉核实、注明每条来源和日期，区分事实和推测

en.name: Web research report
en.description: Use when a report needs research: search several sources, cross-check, cite every source with its date, separate fact from opinion

zh.name: 数据分析摘要
zh.description: 拿到表格或 CSV 数据要出结论时用：先检查数据，再算关键指标，用表格和几句话讲清楚发现

en.name: Data summary
en.description: Use when turning a table or CSV into findings: check the data first, compute key numbers, explain the findings in tables and plain words

zh.name: 每日新闻简报
zh.description: 整理某个领域的最新动态时用：上网查当天或本周的新闻，挑重点、一句话总结、附来源

en.name: News briefing
en.description: Use when summarising the latest news in a field: search today's or this week's news, pick what matters, one line each, with sources
